list.name: logquery
list.label: LogsQL
list.description: Free-form LogsQL filter appended to the source filter

options.content:
| Goal | LogsQL |
|------|--------|
| Specific build | `build_id:1969142006726791168` |
| Error logs | `level:error` |
| Errors with keyword | `level:error AND _msg:~"failed"` |
| By component | `component:metricsAgent` |
| Step failures | `_msg:~"step.*failed"` |
| PR errors | `pr_number:2490 AND level:error` |

Type queries in the **LogsQL** box above. For complex multi-line queries, use [Explore](../explore) with the VictoriaLogs datasource.

[LogsQL reference docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/)
